wish: someone should make a tool that forces me to take rest breaks at the computer
spec:
Counts down a work period, then covers the whole screen (fullscreen where the browser allows) with a break countdown, a chime and a rest tip.
Set work and break minutes, tap start, keep the tab open; breaks repeat until you stop, and settings, running timer and today's taken/skipped count survive a reload.
It cannot lock other apps or the OS; skipping a break is possible only by holding a button for 3 seconds.
notes: Browser tab cannot lock the OS; it takes over the tab and requests fullscreen on break. Skip needs a 3 s hold.
